definitions.explanation: A line that curves up and down in a wave-like pattern. Used in documents, diagrams, and proofreading marks.

examples.japanese: {波線|なみせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}んで→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please circle it with a wavy line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{波線|なみせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: I drew a wavy line under the important parts.

examples.japanese: ⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{波線|なみせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{省略|しょうりゃく}→省略：03244_shouryaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The wavy line in the graph indicates an omission.

notes:
USAGE:
In graphs and charts, a {波線|なみせん} on an axis indicates that part of the scale has been omitted. In proofreading and note-taking, wavy underlines are used to highlight important passages. The tilde character (~) is also sometimes called {波線|なみせん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {波線|なみせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to draw a wavy line)
- {波線|なみせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧ (to enclose with a wavy line)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{点線|てんせん}→点線：18308_tensen⟧: dotted line
- ⟦{実線|じっせん}→実線：20763_jissen⟧: solid line
- ⟦{直線|ちょくせん}→直線：05440_chokusen⟧: straight line
